title: Morning rush in London: every Tube and DLR train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in London, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every Tube and DLR train inside Greater London on an average October weekday. The feed has no London Overground, Elizabeth line or National Rail trains, so they are not shown.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside Greater London are faded and not counted. Colours: Northern, Piccadilly, District, Central, Victoria and DLR, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 496 Tube and DLR trains at 8:31 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
